name: rdm_issue_tag
label: R&D Management Issue Tag Table
description: The issue_tag table is part of the R&D management module and is used for related queries and report scenarios in R&D management.

fields.name: issue_id
fields.description: Issue ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: tag_id
fields.description: The tag association ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the issue_id, tag_id fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_tag_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the tag_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
